landingFaq.title: What parents ask before ordering
landingFaq.subtitle: Clear answers, no small print.
landingFaq.previewQ: Do I see the book before paying?
landingFaq.previewA: Yes. You create their book for free, without signing up, and see the cover with their name, their portrait and the first illustrated scenes of their story. You only pay if you love it.
landingFaq.likenessQ: What if it doesn't look like my child?
landingFaq.likenessA: You decide how they look: skin, hair colour, hairstyle, eyes, glasses and freckles, and you see their portrait before moving on. If you want to change it in the preview, change their look and we paint the book again with the new character; everything else stays. We print it exactly as you see it.
landingFaq.deliveryQ: When does it arrive? Will it arrive for Christmas?
landingFaq.deliveryA: We print it on demand in the EU as soon as you order, and it arrives in 7-10 business days, shipping included. We ship to mainland Spain and the Balearic Islands (not yet to the Canary Islands, Ceuta or Melilla).
landingFaq.deliverySeason: To have it at home for Christmas Eve, order by {christmasDate}; for Three Kings' Day, by {reyesDate}.
landingFaq.deliverySeasonReyes: To have it at home before Three Kings' Day, order by {reyesDate}.
landingFaq.deliverySeasonPdf: The printed book no longer arrives in time for Three Kings' Day, but the PDF story does: it reaches your inbox after payment, usually in under an hour.
landingFaq.priceQ: How much is it and what's included?
landingFaq.priceA: Softcover, {softcover}. Hardcover, {hardcover}. PDF only, {pdf}. All prices include VAT. The printed book includes shipping and the PDF of the full story.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At Meapica, the privacy of our users — especially when it comes to children's data — is our top priority.
privacy.section1Text: The data controller for personal data collected through meapica.com is Xavier Huix Trenco (Meapica), tax ID 41649433K, address Carrer Aribau 140, 5º, 08036 Barcelona (Spain). For any privacy question, write to admin@casmar.tech.
privacy.section2Text: We collect the data needed to create your personalised book: the child's name, age, city, interests and physical features for the illustrations and, only if you choose to upload one, a photo of the child (see section 8). We also collect your email and shipping address to process orders.
privacy.section3Text: We use your data only to: create the personalised story and its illustrated character, process payment and shipping, and contact you about your order. We never sell data to third parties.
privacy.section4Text: Creating, previewing and printing your book, managing your account, payment and shipping: performance of the contract you request (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR). The child's photo: explicit consent of the child's parent or legal guardian (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR and Art. 7 of Spain's LOPDGDD), which you can withdraw at any time. Newsletter and waitlist: your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR), which you can withdraw whenever you like. Keeping invoices and accounting records: legal obligation (Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR). Service security and abuse prevention (for example, usage limits): legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).
privacy.section5Text: To provide the service we work with providers that process data only on our instructions: OpenAI Ireland Ltd. (generating the story text and illustrations and, if you upload one, the character from the photo), Supabase (database and storage), Vercel (web hosting), Stripe Payments Europe Ltd. (payments), Gelato (printing and shipping) and Resend (order emails). OpenAI does not use the data we send it to train its models and may keep it for up to 30 days to detect abuse. When a provider or its sub-processors process data outside the European Economic Area (for example, in the United States), the transfer relies on the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses or the EU-US Data Privacy Framework.
privacy.section6Text: You can exercise your rights of access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction of processing and portability, and withdraw your consent at any time, by writing to admin@casmar.tech. We will reply within one month at the latest. If you believe we have not handled your data properly, you can lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (AEPD, www.aepd.es).
privacy.section7Text: We do not collect data directly from children. The child's data is provided by the parent or legal guardian who creates the book.
privacy.section8Text: Uploading a photo is optional: you can also create the character by choosing their features. If you upload one, we use it only to create the child's illustrated character (their portrait and character sheet), and only with the consent of the child's parent or legal guardian. Before storing it we remove all its metadata, including GPS location, and keep it in private storage that only our server can access. The photo is sent to OpenAI to draw the character; OpenAI does not use it to train its models and may keep it for up to 30 days to detect abuse. We delete the photo as soon as the character is created, and in any case within 24 hours. The book (preview and final version) is illustrated only from the drawn character, never from the photo. We do not use it for facial recognition or for any other purpose. You can withdraw your consent at any time by writing to admin@casmar.tech and we will delete it immediately. We keep a record of your consent (date, version of the accepted text and language) as proof that you gave it.

terms.title: Legal Notice and Terms of Use
terms.intro: By using meapica.com you accept the following terms.
terms.section1Text: Meapica is a personalized children's book creation platform operated from Spain by Xavier Huix Trenco, with registered address at Carrer Aribau 140, 5º, 08036 Barcelona (Spain). Contact: admin@casmar.tech.
terms.section2Text: Meapica offers the creation of personalized children's stories with unique illustrations, printed on demand.
terms.section3Text: Illustrations are created specifically for each book. The buyer receives a personal, non-commercial use license for the purchased book.
terms.section4Text: All prices are final, VAT included, and shown in euros. For printed books, shipping within Spain is included in the price. Payment is processed securely through Stripe.
terms.section5Text: Books are printed on demand in the EU, and for now we only ship to addresses in Spain. Mainland Spain: 7-10 business days. Balearic Islands: 7-10 business days. We don't ship to the Canary Islands, Ceuta or Melilla yet. As personalized products, books are excluded from the right of withdrawal (Art. 103(c) of the Spanish consolidated consumer protection law, TRLGDCU) and cannot be returned. If a book arrives with any printing or manufacturing defect, or is damaged in transit, write to us with a photo and we will send you a new one free of charge. This does not limit your statutory warranty rights.
terms.section6Text: Meapica does not guarantee uninterrupted service availability. Illustrations may vary and a specific result is not guaranteed.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: Meapica uses strictly necessary cookies for the operation of the service.
cookies.section1Text: Cookies are small text files stored in your browser when visiting a website.
cookies.section2Text: We only use technical cookies necessary to: keep your user session active, remember the selected language, and manage the purchase process. We do not use marketing or third-party tracking cookies.
cookies.section3Text: Stripe (payment processor) may set its own cookies during the checkout process. Please refer to Stripe's cookie policy for more information.
cookies.section4Text: You can configure your browser to reject cookies, although this may affect the operation of the service.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.intro: Everything you need to know about Meapica's personalized storybooks.
faq.section1Text: You choose the adventure, customize the character with your child's name, age and features, and our technology writes a unique story with original illustrations. No other child in the world will ever have the same book.
faq.section2Text: Each book is printed on demand in the EU as soon as you order. For now we only ship within Spain. Mainland Spain: 7-10 business days. Balearic Islands: 7-10 business days. We don't ship to the Canary Islands, Ceuta or Melilla yet. You'll receive an email with the tracking number once your parcel is on its way.
faq.section3Text: Yes! You can choose the name, age, hair/eye/skin color, hairstyle, gender, and even add their pet, favorite food, or future dream. Everything appears in the story and illustrations.
faq.section4Text: We print on 170 g coated silk paper, which renders the illustrations in vivid colour with a soft touch. The binding is glued, like a premium photo album, and the cover is matt-laminated. Choose softcover or hardcover, the sturdiest option.
faq.section5Title: Can I request changes after purchase?
faq.section5Text: Since each book is a unique edition generated on the spot, it cannot be modified once created. That's why we show you a full preview before purchase, so you can review the story and illustrations.
faq.section6Text: The book measures 20×20 cm (8×8 inches), the ideal format for little hands. It has 30 pages with 12 illustrated scenes, a cover, a personalized dedication and a back cover.

shipping.title: Shipping & Packaging
shipping.intro: Every Meapica book is a gift. That's why the experience of receiving it at home should be as special as opening it.
shipping.section1Text: For now we only ship within Spain. Mainland Spain: 7-10 business days. Balearic Islands: 7-10 business days. We don't ship to the Canary Islands, Ceuta or Melilla yet. Each book is printed on demand in the EU, so the timeframe includes printing.
shipping.section2Text: Standard shipping is included in the book price, which already includes VAT. No hidden costs or surprises in the box.
shipping.section3Text: Your book travels in cardboard packaging designed to get it to you in perfect condition, ready to give. If it still arrives damaged, write to us and we'll send you a new one free of charge.
shipping.section4Text: Once the book leaves the printer, you'll receive an email with the tracking number. You can also check your order status from your user dashboard at meapica.com.

christmasDelivery.metaTitle: Will it arrive by Three Kings' Day {reyesYear}? Order deadlines
christmasDelivery.metaDescription: Last order dates for a printed personalized children's book to arrive by Christmas Eve or Three Kings' Day in Spain. Dates per format, mainland Spain and the Balearic Islands. The PDF always arrives in time.
christmasDelivery.h1: Will it arrive in time for Three Kings' Day?
christmasDelivery.intro: These are the last order dates to get your printed personalized book home by Christmas Eve or before the night of the Three Kings. We base them on real printing and delivery times, with extra margin for December.
christmasDelivery.daysLeft: {days, plural, =0 {Today is the last day} one {# day left} other {# days left}}

countdownDetail.christmas: to order it printed and have it home by Christmas Eve. Last day: {date}.
countdownDetail.reyes: to order it printed and have it home before Three Kings' Day. Last day: {date}.

christmasDelivery.digitalTitle: The printed book won't arrive in time any more
christmasDelivery.digitalDetail: The PDF will: it reaches your inbox after payment, usually in under an hour, ready to print at home or read together on a tablet.
christmasDelivery.formatsSub: Delivery included in the price to mainland Spain and the Balearic Islands.
christmasDelivery.pdfDetail: It reaches your inbox after payment, usually in under an hour. You can order it even on 5 January.
christmasDelivery.regionNote: We don't ship to the Canary Islands, Ceuta or Melilla yet. If the gift is for there, the PDF story works just as well.
christmasDelivery.methodHeading: How we work out these dates
method: Every book is printed on demand in the EU. Today, printing plus delivery takes {min}-{max} calendar days door to door.
In December we add {buffer} days of margin for carrier backlogs and the 8 December, Christmas and New Year holidays.
The clock starts when you complete payment, not when you start creating the story.
These are estimates based on current carrier times, not a guarantee. If they change, we update this page.
christmasDelivery.lateText: The PDF story is the same book: the same illustrations and their name on every page. It reaches your inbox after payment, so it arrives in time for Christmas Eve and Three Kings' Day even if you order on the day. Print it at home or at a print shop, or read it together on a tablet.

faq.reyesQ: What is the last day to order a personalized book for Three Kings' Day?
faq.reyesA: To have the printed book home before 5 January, order by {date}. The PDF story can be ordered even on 5 January.
faq.christmasQ: And to have it by Christmas Eve?
faq.christmasA: To have the printed book home on 24 December, order by {date}. After that you can still give the PDF story.
faq.timeQ: How long does the printed book take to arrive?
faq.timeA: We print it on demand in the EU as soon as you order. Mainland Spain and the Balearic Islands: 7-10 working days, with delivery included in the price. You'll get the tracking number by email.
faq.regionQ: Do you ship to the Canary Islands, Ceuta or Melilla?
faq.regionA: Not yet. If the gift is for there, the PDF story reaches your inbox and you can print it or read it on a tablet.
